seg.notes: Full-year bridge from 2020 10-K (Freight product-line organic: Equipment -333.9, Components -258.7, Digital Electronics -51.8, Services -189.0; Transit OEM -158.7, Aftermarket -148.2). Adjusted segment op income from Q4-20 release Appendix G: Freight 583.9 + restructuring & transaction 75.9 + amortization 262.3 = 922.1 (18.1%); Transit 229.7 + 28.3 + 20.1 = 278.1 (11.2%). corp_op from 10-K segment note. Backlog rollforward (10-K): Dec-31-2019 22,431.7 + new orders 6,777.7 (Freight 4,255.2, Transit 2,522.5) - sales 7,556.1 - adj/FX 62.1 = 21,591.3. RPO $20.8bn at Dec-31-2020 (~25% within 12 months).

items.other_label: restructuring = combined 'Restructuring & Transaction costs' row (incl. cost-of-sales portion) as published (transaction=null); amortization = 'Non-cash Amortization expense'; nonop = foreign exchange (and interest) loss/gain row in 'Interest & Other Exp'; discrete_tax = 'Tax on Transaction Costs' where present.

ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance (Feb-18-2021): sales $7.6-$7.9bn; GAAP diluted EPS $2.65-$3.05; adjusted EPS $3.90-$4.30 (excl. restructuring and amortization); run-rate synergies $250m in 2021; operating cash flow conversion >90%; share buyback authorization renewed up to $500m.
ngaap.notes: 2020 'adjusted' definition: excludes restructuring & transaction costs (incl. cost-of-sales portion), all non-cash intangible amortization expense, foreign exchange (and in Q3 interest) gains/losses in other income, and tax on transaction costs; all tax-effected. EBITDA (2020 definition) = income from operations + other income (expense) + depreciation & amortization; Adjusted EBITDA adds back restructuring & transaction costs. FY2020 CFO $784m incl. ~$220m one-time restructuring/transaction/litigation cash impacts; ~$300m returned to shareholders (buybacks $207.2m + dividends $92.5m).
